# House of Chirmi

> House of Chirmi is a Shopify design and development studio based in India. It designs, builds and grows online stores for Indian fashion, jewellery and craft brands, and offers monthly brand partnerships. Not to be confused with "Home of Chirmi", a separate Jaipur furniture brand.

- Website: https://www.houseofchirmi.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/houseofchirmi/ (main) and https://www.instagram.com/houseofchirmi.studio/ (websites)
- Contact: khushisesma25@gmail.com · WhatsApp +91 96605 70279

## Services
- [Shopify storefronts](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/studio): Launch ₹35,000 (10 days), Growth ₹65,000 (3 weeks), Signature ₹1,10,000
- [Brand partnership](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/brands): monthly, from ₹22,000

## Work (live Shopify stores)
- [Rawish Designs](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/work/rawish-designs) — Kashmiri craft
- [Lakhmanis](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/work/lakhmanis) — ethnic wear
- [Dumroo](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/work/dumroo) — jewellery
- [Reba Aura](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/work/reba-aura) — heritage jewellery
- [Kaarmugizh](https://www.houseofchirmi.com/work/kaarmugizh) — handloom
